versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Windows File Search Skill.
- Provides fast and advanced file/folder search on Windows using Everything (es.exe) command line tool.
- Includes automatic error handling and compatibility support for Everything 1.4 and 1.5a.
- Detailed setup instructions and troubleshooting for es.exe installation/configuration.
- Supports extensive search options, filters, sorting, data export, and result formatting.
